description: France's company register (INSEE Sirene) as a complete typed archive: every French legal person — sociétés, associations, public bodies — with SIREN identity, legal form, NAF/APE activity code, creation date, headcount band and head-office (siège) location, plus derived analytics (creations by month, by NAF sector, by département). Entrepreneurs individuels (sole traders) are excluded by design — their registered names are individuals. Source: INSEE via data.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte 2.0. Independent tool; not affiliated with INSEE or Etalab.
name: france-sirene-register
title: France Sirene Register — French Companies, Legal Forms & NAF Analytics
